summary: Sidebar/kanban/conversation-list previews used to show the first raw, mid-sentence words of the latest assistant reply. The agent now reports a one-line status wrapped in <agent_digest>...</agent_digest> (a prompt rule appended for Claude and Codex, which have a clean instructions seam; OpenCode's ACP does not, so it keeps today's raw preview). src/shared/agent-digest.ts is pure and provider-agnostic: extractDigest pulls the last complete tag for previews (capped ~120 chars), stripDigest removes it from the text shown in the transcript, including hiding a still-streaming partial tag so it never flashes on screen. The raw message is stored unchanged everywhere - both functions run at render time only, so previews are derived live from in-memory session/thread state (agent-store on desktop, the chat store on mobile) and reset on reload rather than needing a DB migration.

nativeAndroid.followUpRelease: Native Android gains the conversation-list digest preview once BrowseThreadActivityIndex accumulates live assistant text per thread (it currently tracks only status/unread/pending-attention, not content) the way the desktop agent-store and the mobile chat store already do; until then the conversation list shows today's status/time only, with no raw tag and no preview line. The required, unflagged part - stripping <agent_digest> out of the rendered transcript so a raw tag never shows on the phone - already ships unconditionally, no flag needed.

storageDataMigration.reason: The raw message/content text is stored unchanged everywhere (ChatMessage.content on desktop, FeedItem.text on mobile and Android) - extractDigest/stripDigest run at render time only, deriving the preview from in-memory session state. No column, table, or wire-format field was added, and no migration is touched.

cd apps/android && JAVA_HOME=/opt/homebrew/opt/openjdk@21 ./gradlew testDebugUnitTest: AgentDigestTest, the Kotlin port of the shared extractDigest/stripDigest test suite
notExercised: No live Claude or Codex turn was run against a real account with the appended prompt rule; the systemPrompt/developerInstructions wiring was verified by unit test and by reading the installed codex-cli's generated JSON schema (ThreadStartParams/ThreadResumeParams), not by observing a real agent emit a tag.
The claim that OpenCode's ACP has no instructions seam was checked by reading @agentclientprotocol/sdk's NewSessionRequest/PromptRequest types, not by probing a live opencode acp session.
The Android conversation-list digest preview is staged and unbuilt, so it has nothing to exercise yet.
Android's chat-text stripping (ThreadScreen.kt TextRow) was verified only via AgentDigestTest.kt's JVM unit tests, not on a physical device or emulator.

The desktop sidebar Recents preview and kanban card preview were not visually verified in a running build - only through renderToStaticMarkup-based unit tests and the pure previewLine/sessionPreviewLine helpers.
